_readme: Notes for the chatbot only - never shown on the website (Netlify only publishes frontend/). Keyed by each artwork page's filename. 'colours' and 'shows' describe what the painting looks like, so visitors can search by colour or subject; 'about' adds facts about public subjects. Edit freely: any change here is picked up on the next deploy, which re-indexes automatically.
